ex: The victim had been stabbed repeatedly in the chest.
受害者胸部多处被刺伤。

en: a gun that you can fire several times without having to load it again

zh: a decimal in which the same figure or group of figures is repeated forever, for example 3.999…
en: a decimal in which the same figure or group of figures is repeated forever, for example 3.999…
to successfully fight somebody who is attacking you, your country, etc. and drive them away
ex: to repel an attack/invasion/invader
击退进攻／入侵；驱逐入侵者

zh: 使人反感的；令人厌恶的
en: very unpleasant; causing strong dislike
ex: I found the pictures repellent.
我发现这些图片令人讨厌。

en: to feel and show that you are sorry for something bad or wrong that you have done
ex: God welcomes the sinner who repents.
上帝欢迎悔过的罪人。

en: the fact of showing that you are sorry for something wrong that you have done
ex: He shows no sign of repentance.
他毫无悔意。

zh: 后悔的；悔过的；表示悔改的
en: feeling or showing that you are sorry for something wrong that you have done
ex: She was not in the least repentant.
她一点也不悔改。

en: an indirect and usually bad result of an action or event that may happen some time afterwards
ex: The collapse of the company will have repercussions for the whole industry.
这家公司的垮台将会给整个行业造成间接的负面影响。

en: all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer knows and can perform
ex: to add to/extend your repertoire
添加/扩展您的曲目

en: the type of work of a theatre company in which different plays are performed for short periods of time
ex: an actor in repertory
参加轮演剧目的演员

en: the fact of doing or saying the same thing many times
ex: learning by repetition
通过重复来学习

zh: 重复的；一再的；重复乏味的
en: involving something that is often repeated, in a way that becomes boring
ex: a long and repetitious speech
冗长重复的讲话

zh: 重复的；一再的；重复乏味的
en: repeatedly, in a way that becomes boring
